newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merita CEO says EMU will not hit earnings.
newsitem.headline: Merita CEO says EMU will not hit earnings.

text.p: Finnish banking group Merita Oy's CEO Vesa Vainio said on Monday its group earnings should not be reduced if Finland joined EMU.
"There is no reason to think that Merita's earnings would be smaller if Finland joins European economic and monetary union," Vainio said in the text of a speech prepared for delivery at a seminar.

"Although the euro will reduce part of revenue, as a whole the group's prospects will strengthen," Vainio said. He saw scope for new revenue mainly on commissions from the management of share and debt issues, and from securities transactions. @
